summary.en: Gilead is building long-acting HIV combinations while expanding oncology and inflammation. Acquired cell therapies, ADCs and autoimmune programs complement internal discovery.
summary.zh: Gilead正在构建长效HIV联合疗法,同时拓展肿瘤和炎症领域。收购的细胞疗法、ADC和自身免疫项目与内部研发互为补充。

counts.note: Company pipeline updated October 29, 2026, data at end-Q3: 49 clinical-stage programs, excluding opt-in/planned programs. A separate registration count was not stated; reg is null. These are programs, not unique assets.

watch.en: Q3 HIV sales were $6.2 billion; Biktarvy alone contributed $4.1 billion.
watch.zh: 第三季度HIV销售额为62亿美元;仅Biktarvy就贡献41亿美元。

watch.en: Biktarvy's Medicare negotiated price takes effect January 1, 2028.
watch.zh: Biktarvy的Medicare谈判价格自2028年1月1日起生效。

watch.en: Anito-cel's FDA target date is December 23, 2026.
Arcellx, Tubulis and Ouro expanded the portfolio; acquisition integration and development spending remain relevant.
watch.zh: Arcellx、Tubulis和Ouro扩充了产品组合;收购整合和研发支出仍需关注。

watch.en: KITE-753's Phase 2 studies were partially held while safety differences were investigated.
watch.zh: KITE-753的II期研究在调查安全性差异期间被部分搁置。

sources: Phase 3 ISL/LEN results and Merck collaboration, June 2026
Gilead HIV Glasgow poster: GS-3242 mechanism and ongoing oral/injectable Phase 2 combinations, November 2026
Immunomedics acquisition completed including TROP-2 ADC Trodelvy, October 2020
gaps: reg is null within counts because no separate company registration count was verified; 24/12/13 are company-reported clinical programs and must not be interpreted as deduplicated assets.

Origins were not verified for the LEN/teropavimab/zinlirvimab combination, GS-3242/LEN combination and edecesertib; their origins are null. Separate codes for anito-cel, ISL/LEN, the three-drug regimen and edecesertib were not verified.
GS-3242/LEN oral and injectable Phase 2 programs are consolidated into one entry; individual broadly neutralizing antibodies are not duplicated.

Gamgertamig is acquired via Ouro and subsequently co-developed with Lakefront. June's company release labels it Phase 2, whereas Q3 remarks discuss Phase 1 data; phase 2 follows the explicit development-stage statement, not the phase of the next data presentation.
The April 2026 Arcellx acquisition source predates 2026-06 and is used for provenance only; current regulatory status uses October remarks. GS-8824 remains Phase 1 despite its strategic importance.
The mixed antibody/small-molecule three-drug regimen is mapped to other.

Added Trodelvy/sacituzumab govitecan for the major new Phase 3 endometrial-cancer indication highlighted in Q3 remarks, with an update expected around year-end 2026. Approved Bixlenvo/Hepcludex uses and dosing-only lenacapavir PrEP extensions remain excluded.

GS-3242/LEN has an explicitly stated next step (twice-yearly injectable cohort after further Phase 1 data), but no date. No next event was established for LEN/teropavimab/zinlirvimab, edecesertib or GS-8824. The November 8 edecesertib presentation has passed.

Trodelvy target and acquisition provenance use the October 2020 Immunomedics closing release, older than June 2026; the new endometrial indication phase and year-end guidance use October 2026 remarks.
